processFindings: PROCESS-1 (repeat of r2 ADV-4): canonical desk filenames were overwritten in place during an open review stage; the r2 record already established the rule - a candidate or emission admitted to a stage is immutable at its content address on disk; revisions reissue under monotonic ids with superseded addresses recorded.

PROCESS-2: the canonical namespace ended up MIXED (A submission + B verification/review/trace/summary) - filename-keyed consumers would assemble a Frankenstein record; content addressing is the only safe transport (CON-1).

PROCESS-3: emission B records a verdict (accepted) whose recorded verification surface does not cover the documented failure modes; an acceptance without the status-layer audit is exactly the "not recomputation-backed positive finding" defect the r2 reviews named.
